First release of AudioVisualizer.

## What it is
- Audio-reactive 3D visualizations that run entirely in the browser, built with three.js.
- Ported from Angular to React 19 and React Router 8 (framework mode, static SPA), with all audio analysis done client-side.

## Visualizers
- **Cubes**: a grid of cubes that moves with the music.
- **Trio color wave**: a three-color wave surface driven by the low, mid and high bands.
- Each has a settings panel, a camera lock and a reset-view control.

## Audio sources
- Capture screen or tab audio, or pick an input device such as Stereo Mix.
- The source can be switched at any time without leaving the visualizer.

## Rhythm tracker
- Estimates tempo, locks onto the beat, tells 3/4 from 4/4 meter, and notices song changes.
- Visualizers can follow the beat and bar phase.

## Performance
- The landing title is a pre-rendered static image and the Inter font is self-hosted.
- Card images are responsive AVIF/WebP, and hashed assets are cached for a year.
- Lighthouse and bundle-size budgets keep it from regressing.

## CI/CD
- Every pull request runs format, lint, type-check, unit tests (95% coverage) and a build, plus a bundle-size budget.
- Sharded Playwright end-to-end tests cover behavior, accessibility (axe) and visual regression.
- Lighthouse, dependency audit and review, and CodeQL run on every PR.
- Cloudflare deploys a preview for each PR and production for each push to main, followed by a production smoke test.
- Versions and releases are automated from Conventional Commit PR titles.
